name: Lich
description: A rotten necromancer, an ancient lich, a phantasmal sorcerer.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: Choose Blood, Bone or Plasm as the leader’s keyword. **Bone:** the leader improves their violence by 1. **Blood:** the leader gains +2 max hp. **Plasm:** the leader gains the fly keyword and −2hp and cannot wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Mana and spells
rules.text: Divide 4 mana points between Blood/Bone/Plasm. Gain the Summon spell and choose 3 additional spells. Choose 1 Basic Leader Trait.

rules.name: Caster
rules.text: A lich cannot wear heavy armour or carry a shield.

name: Revenant
description: A desiccated knight, a barrow monarch, a spectral martyr.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: Choose Blood, Bone or Plasm as the leader’s keyword. **Bone:** the leader improves their violence by 1. **Blood:** the leader gains +2 max hp. **Plasm:** the leader gains the fly keyword and −2hp and cannot wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Mana and spells
rules.text: Divide 3 mana points between Blood/Bone/Plasm. Gain the Summon spell and choose 1 additional spell. Choose 1 Basic Leader Trait.

rules.name: Ancient Skill
rules.text: During this model’s attack action if any dice rolled is an unmodified 10 that dice is considered a critical hit, critical hits do an additional +1 damage. E.g. if a model with a blade (Damage 1/3) scores a glance (1 damage), a hit (3 damage) and a critical hit (3+1 damage) that attack action would do 8 damage.

rules.name: Fighter
rules.text: A revenant can never gain more than 4 spells (including summon) and 4 mana points.

name: Ascended Undead
description: An imposing pontiff of sewn corpses, a multi limbed skeletal sorcerer-monarch, spectral death incarnate.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: Choose Blood, Bone or Plasm as the leader’s keyword. **Bone:** the leader improves their violence by 1. **Blood:** the leader gains +2 max hp. **Plasm:** the leader gains the fly keyword and −2hp and cannot wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Mana and spells
rules.text: Divide 5 mana points between Blood/Bone/Plasm. Gain the Summon spell and choose 3 additional spells. Choose 1 Basic Leader Trait.

rules.name: Colossal
rules.text: This model can only take weapons from the Colossal Weapons list.

rules.name: Threatening Aura
rules.text: This model may take the Lurk action for 0 AP cost once per turn.

name: Husk
description: A golem of blood, an ossified horror, a spectre of a scorned lover.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: The miniature gains the skill matching their chosen keyword. **Bone:** improves Violence by 1. **Blood:** improves HP by 2. **Plasm:** gains the fly keyword, −2 hp and may not wear heavy armour.

name: Aberrant Husk
description: A towering corpse, a great knight entombed in armour, a huge ghostly executioner.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: The miniature gains the skill matching their chosen keyword. **Bone:** improves Violence by 1. **Blood:** improves HP by 2. **Plasm:** gains the fly keyword, −2 hp and may not wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Brutal
rules.text: When this model performs an attack action, add +1 to the damage total.

name: Familiar
description: A dark swarm of bats, a skull faced crow, a poltergeist.

rules.name: Blood, Bone or Plasm
rules.text: The miniature gains the skill matching their chosen keyword. **Bone:** improves Violence by 1. **Blood:** improves HP by 2. **Plasm:** gains the fly keyword, −2 hp and may not wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.text: Familiar can only take claws and fangs as a weapon. Familiar cannot wear armour or carry a shield.

rules.name: Unique
rules.text: Each gathering may only take 1 familiar.

rules.name: Soul Link
rules.text: If a familiar moves or is pushed across or into base contact with a mana token, the Gathering receives additional mana dice of that type for its mana pool. The token is then removed.

name: Necromantic Remnant
description: A bone construct centipede, a herald homunculus, a wisp knight.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.text: Necromantic Remnant cannot take 2h weapons apart from claws and fangs.

rules.name: Plasm
rules.text: If this model chooses the *Plasm* keyword it gains the *fly* keyword and −1 HP.

name: Small Beast
description: The remains of a wolf, a twisting mass of bones.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.text: Small beast can only take claws and fangs as a weapon. Small beast cannot carry a shield or wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Plasm
rules.text: If this model chooses the Plasm keyword it gains the fly keyword and −2 HP.

name: Large Beast
description: A patchwork beast, a tide of six dozen skulls.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.text: Large Beast can only take Claws and Fangs or Large Claws as a weapon. Large Beast cannot carry a Shield.

rules.name: Unique
rules.text: Each gathering may only take 1 Large Beast.

name: Gigantic Horror
description: A rotten chimeric horror, the skeleton of a giant knight, a screaming mass of souls.

rules.name: Plasm
rules.text: If this model chooses the Plasm keyword it gains the fly keyword, −2 HP and cannot wear heavy armour.

rules.name: Colossal
rules.text: This model can only take weapons from the Colossal Weapons list.

rules.name: Unique
rules.text: Each gathering may only take 1 Gigantic Horror.

rules.name: Threatening Aura
rules.text: This model may take the Lurk action for 0 AP cost once per turn.

name: Flying Beast
description: A fell bat, a skeletal winged horror.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.text: Flying beast can only take claws and fangs as a weapon. Flying Beast cannot wear armour or carry a shield.
